title: Lacks a good chopping knife.
text: Lacks a good chopping knife.. This set would probably be 5 stars if it included a good chopping knife. It's impossible to chop something like celery with a serrated knife which every blade in this set is. For sharpness testing I cut a tomato which is hard to thinly without a sharp knife and they did a decent job. They are sharp enough for the pricepoint, but the set of chopping knives I picked up at target about 10 years ago for not a lot of money exceed the chopping ability of all these knives even after 10 years. Also the feel of the handles is comfortable but feels kind of cheap since it's so lightweight. For someone who doesn't do a ton of cooking these would prob make a great first set of knives.
